mapper.sql: SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.trigger_id, t.rule_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockId')) AS UNSIGNED) AS stock_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockSymbol')) AS stock_symbol, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockName')) AS stock_name, t.trigger_price, t.event_time, n.title, n.content, n.status, n.read_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM notifications n JOIN alert_triggers t ON t.id = n.trigger_id JOIN alert_rules r ON r.id = t.rule_id JOIN quote_events q ON q.id = t.quote_event_id AND q.origin_type = 'REAL'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trigger_id, r.user_id, r.id AS rule_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockId')) AS UNSIGNED) AS stock_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockSymbol')) AS stock_symbol, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_snapshot, '$.stockName')) AS stock_name, t.trigger_price, t.event_time, t.rule_snapshot, t.trigger_context, q.origin_type FROM alert_triggers t JOIN alert_rules r ON r.id = t.rule_id JOIN quote_events q ON q.id = t.quote_event_id WHERE t.id = #{triggerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, trigger_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{triggerId}, #{title}, #{content}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trigger_id = notifications.trigger_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.status = 'UNREAD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unread_count FROM notifications n JOIN alert_triggers t ON t.id = n.trigger_id JOIN quote_events q ON q.id = t.quote_event_id AND q.origin_type = 'REAL' WHERE n.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications n JOIN alert_triggers t ON t.id = n.trigger_id JOIN quote_events q ON q.id = t.quote_event_id AND q.origin_type = 'REAL' SET n.status = 'READ', n.read_at = COALESCE(n.read_at, #{readAt}) WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} AND n.user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE notifications n JOIN alert_triggers t ON t.id = n.trigger_id JOIN quote_events q ON q.id = t.quote_event_id AND q.origin_type = 'REAL' SET n.status = 'READ', n.read_at = COALESCE(n.read_at, #{readAt}) WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.status = 'UNREAD'
